jobTarget.description: Set the technical direction for a core payments estate. You will own ledger and settlement architecture, regulatory reporting trade-offs, and the engineering standards across four teams.

content.title: Profile
content.html: Engineer and maintainer working on payment infrastructure and reliability practice. Eight years across ledger systems, settlement and on-call, with open-source tools used outside the companies that funded them. I write and speak about reconciliation and incident response.

data.description: Payments platform serving 1,400 merchants across Australia and New Zealand.
highlights: Rewrote the double-entry ledger's posting path in Go, cutting p99 authorisation latency from 240 ms to 149 ms.
Led a six-engineer migration to event-sourced settlement; reconciled all AUD 4.2 billion of annual volume with no customer-visible incidents.
Cut settlement compute spend by 22% (AUD 310k a year) by right-sizing workers and autoscaling on queue depth.
Built a dispute-reconciliation service that flags merchant issues in under five minutes.

data.description: Multi-tenant billing and invoicing for mid-market SaaS companies.
highlights: Designed a billing pipeline issuing 2.3M invoices a month at a 0.02% error rate.
Reduced incident MTTR from 54 to 18 minutes with SLOs and templated runbooks.
Mentored four engineers; two were promoted within 18 months.
